## Overview

An AI coworker that takes a new Sales Development Rep from offer letter to certification. It drafts a personalized onboarding plan, matches a mentor, answers product and policy questions with citations, runs practice cold calls, scores real calls, and produces an evidence-backed certification recommendation. Every AI output stops at a human approve, edit, reject, or escalate gate, and every decision is logged.

**Code:** [github.com/rsm-sanekar/sdr-onboarding-agent](https://github.com/rsm-sanekar/sdr-onboarding-agent)

## Problem

SDR onboarding is manual and inconsistent. Plans take about two hours per hire to customize, managers spend 3 to 5 hours a week reviewing calls with 24 to 72 hour feedback lag, and certification decisions have little documented evidence behind them.

## What I built

- **7 LLM skills and 2 deterministic automations**, chained through a shared JSON envelope with confidence scores and review flags
- **Two retrievers over a 16-document knowledge base:** BM25 for the pipeline steps and ChromaDB semantic search for the AI Tutor, with approved answers written back into the index
- **Hallucination guards:** generated plans are checked against a module allow-list, and certification verdicts are recomputed server-side from the scores
- **MCP servers** that expose the data and workflow steps as tools an agent can call
- **FastAPI orchestrator and a React UI** with 9 screens across manager and trainee views

## Results

| Area | Result |
|------|--------|
| Pre-boarding plan | ~90 to 150 min down to 10 to 20 min of manager time (estimated) |
| Certification gap analysis | ~45 to 75 min down to 10 to 15 min per rep (estimated) |
| Automated tests | 153 pytest tests, fully offline |
| LLM quality (DeepEval) | Mean passes rose from 21.3 to 23.3 of 40, and run-to-run range tightened from 3 to 1 |

## Tech Stack

`Python` · `FastAPI` · `React` · `ChromaDB` · `BM25` · `MCP` · `LLM APIs` · `pytest` · `DeepEval`
